name: impact-review held-out audit 2026-10-01
selection: Top 15 uncited paper nominations per target from researchwiki check-coverage, before impact scores were inspected. All nominated pairs were labeled.
reviewer: Codex, single reviewer; no independent adjudication
criterion: Relevant means the paper could materially change an existing claim, comparison axis, caveat, or proposed design; topical similarity alone is insufficient.

On three simulated GWAS (249,024 SNPs each), meta-analysis mode found 239 SNPs but only 119 replicated — the 120-SNP gap is the follow-up candidate list. EM parameters scale 3ⁿ, capping practical use near 5–6 studies.
